after.abbreviationType: IE is the national LSC code; IES is used in the bylaws.
after.summary: USA Swimming’s Inland Empire Local Swimming Committee administers swimming in its designated parts of Washington, Idaho and Oregon. It belongs to the Western Zone. Its official club directory lists 19 clubs, all included in this proposal.
after.geographicCoverage: Idaho from Idaho County northward; Oregon’s Umatilla, Union, Wallowa and Baker counties; Washington east of and including Okanogan, Chelan, Kittitas and Yakima counties, plus Klickitat east of Highway 97 including Goldendale (USA Swimming LSC map, page 18).
